Prevention: Take soils for testing to evaluate
Do not over apply phosphorus fertilizer- DAP (diammonium phosphate),N:P:K, MAP (mono- ammonium phosphate) because it suppresses the uptake of zinc
Monitoring: Additional relevant crops: baby corn, banana, carrots, soybeans, wheat, rice, cabbages
Check out symptoms in younger leaves and growing points
Look for broadband of white and yellow chlorosis appearing on both sides of mid rib starting at the base of the leaf which does not extend to leaf tip
Look for green midribs and outer leaf edges
Check for bronzing of chlorotic areas
Check for stunting and shortening of internodes
Direct Control: Apply foliar feed at the onset of deficiency symptoms
Restrictions: Always wear protective gear when applying fertilizers
Wash protective gear after fertilizer application
Store gear and application apparatus separate from household appliances
Do not use hooks when transporting fertilizers
Sulphate fertilizer at the rate of 1.6kg
Zinc fertilizer applied on soil is more effective than foliar
applied zinc in addressing zinc deficiency
